items.title: Bloom Energy (BE) Says Its Fuel Cells Can Power AI Data Centers Within Months
items.summary: Bloom Energy (NYSE:BE) is pitching its onsite fuel cell systems as a way to power AI data centers without waiting for new grid connections. The firm says these modular fuel cell units can be installed and activated within months, compared with multi year utility interconnection timelines. Bloom Energy points to Oracle's Utah data center as an example where its technology already supports large scale computing workloads.
